name: @adr/block-console
//private: Never published: the workspace is a vendored template, so every package in it is private, none carries a publishConfig, and none carries a version.
//exports: THE REGISTRATION, and nothing else - the ratified decision's wording, taken literally: one published subpath per block. Everything else in the folder (contract, slice, tools, fold, project, view-state, the adapter, the co-located test) is unreachable by any bare specifier, as a resolution error rather than a lint message. The composition root binds a live client by reaching `../blocks/<x>/adapter` relatively, which resolves because the root REFERENCES this project; publishing a second subpath for it would widen the one route the wall cannot close from one bare specifier to two.
